consequence.statement: A new optional cache statistic becomes available for monitoring query results served from cache; existing configurations are not affected.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new cache statistic `query_length_served` to the Results Cache to measure the length of query results served from cache.

decision.reason: [ev-daa5d5e91665] lists this under Features: it only adds a `query_length_served` stat to the results cache to measure how much of a query was served from cache. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, is no longer honoured or must be migrated, and no existing default changes. So the change is additive, and "none" (informational) is the right consequence.
